html:
SMTO-CTX-0026 — This part of an attached file is too large for the AI model

GUID: 2025dd08-c399-4d13-827c-d70aab63b1ac
Slug: context-read-exceeds-model-budget
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: ctx

What happened

  • The task tried to read a piece of an attached file, but that piece would not fit in the AI model's space next to everything else the task already holds. None of the file's text was given to the model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the task for a moment. It is usually told to ask for a smaller piece of the file and can continue by itself. Nothing was read yet, so reading a smaller piece starts in the same place without losing anything.
  2. If the task stops, open Settings › Agent behavior › Context & Attachments and lower Maximum characters per Context read (the default is 12000). This makes each piece of the file smaller so it fits next to the rest of the task.
  3. Start a new task for the remaining work, and attach only the files it needs. Settings changes apply to new tasks; the current task keeps the read size it started with.
  4. If even small pieces don't fit, ask the person who manages SMTO to use a model with more space in Settings › Setup › Model routing. When the task's history already fills most of the model's space, only a larger model leaves room for more file text.

What success looks like

  • The task reads the file piece by piece and keeps going without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; they show the file's size and how much space was left. Don't raise timeouts or rerun earlier steps; they don't make more room.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Context-read admission found that the next complete model request, including the requested bounded page of attached source text, exceeds the context window after preserved input and reserved output; no source text was delivered.

What this means

  • Admission measures the next intact model request including the proposed bounded context page; preserved input and output reservation leave insufficient room for that page. Context admission, storage and reading are separate from executing a tool mutation. Preserve existing task state and receipts; a context diagnostic does not authorize replay of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • Admission measures the next intact model request including the proposed bounded context page; preserved input and output reservation leave insufficient room for that page.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare available input capacity after retained messages with the requested page and measurement provenance; the full model window is not all available for new source text.

How to fix it

  • Request a smaller page with read_context (fewer characters, continuing from the returned next_cursor), or lower Maximum characters per Context read in Settings > Agent behavior > Context & Attachments for new tasks; for more capacity use a larger-context model or a lower Output allowance in Settings > Setup > Model routing for a new task. The active run keeps its captured read policy and model profile; repeating the same read unchanged cannot fit, and timeouts or replaying earlier operations do not help.
  • Request a smaller bounded page of source text. If necessary, choose a model with sufficient verified capacity for a new task. The active task retains its captured read policy and model configuration.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeating the same read without reducing its size or changing the task capacity cannot make it fit. No source text was delivered.

How to verify the fix

  • A smaller page fits with retained input and output reservation and is returned with a continuation cursor.

What not to do

  • Do not increase a timeout or replay completed operations to address a token-capacity failure.
  • Do not delete retained receipts or truncate protected input to make the read fit.

Technical notes

  • Context admission, storage and reading are separate from executing a tool mutation. Preserve existing task state and receipts; a context diagnostic does not authorize replay of earlier operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0027 — An attached file is too large for the AI model to read in full
  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
